title: News of Harmandir Sahib’s Desecration Provokes Mehtab Singh

blocks.text: The next outrage surpasses ordinary persecution. Reports spread of the desecration of Harmandir Sahib after Massa Ranghar takes possession of the sacred precincts and treats the shrine as a place for worldly revelry.

Mehtab Singh’s anger becomes the center of the page. He cannot bear that Amritsar should suffer such humiliation while the Khalsa remains scattered, and he challenges the Singhs around him to answer dishonor with courage.

The conversation is therefore not only about one enemy official but about Sikh responsibility itself. By turning grief into rebuke, the page prepares for a mission that will demand both stealth and martyr-like resolve.
